description: ZAPE - Barragem (base cartográfica) [CNPS] is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Esta base de dados representa a localização das barragens para o estado de Pernambuco, escala 1:100.000. Base de dados vetorizada a partir das cartas planialtimétricas (1:100.000) da SUDENE (DSG). Trabalho foi elaborado pela equipe de geoprocessamento da Unidade de Execução de Pesquisas (UEP-Recife) da Embrapa Solos. [CNPS]. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Barragem, CNPS, Nordeste, Pernambuco, ZAPE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
